caption: The drawing depicts a two-wheeled wooden cart with large, spoked wheels and a long handle extending from its front, oriented toward the lower left of the image. The cart consists of a frame made of rectangular wooden beams with additional wooden elements forming the axle and support structures. The two wheels are positioned parallel to one another and are circular with multiple spokes radiating from central hubs. At the rear end of the cart, several flat wooden planks are placed transversely, forming a small platform. The cart is rendered in shades of brown, representing the wood grain and texture, while the background is a plain, light beige color with no additional objects or scenery. The artist's signature and the year "1938" appear below the cart, in small, neat handwriting.
title: Model Potato Planter
